from itertools import combinations

    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    friendships = set()
    index = 2
    for _ in range(m):
        ai = int(data[index])
        bi = int(data[index + 1])
        friendships.add((min(ai, bi), max(ai, bi)))
        index += 2
    
    for x, y, z in combinations(range(1, n + 1), 3):
        if (x, y) in friendships and (y, z) in friendships and (x, z) not in friendships:
            print("NO")
            return
    
    print("YES")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
